name: 音声の入力方式と自動感度
prompt:
Correct v001 to match the exact 390×280 native component. The v001 card landed about 4px too far left, 5px too low, and 8px too wide; a few text rows are also slightly low. Move and size the elements to the exact native coordinates below. Keep the clean white card treatment and the same Japanese text and state.

User-directed no-tint rule: use a white (#FFFFFF) page and white card with a thin neutral light-gray (#E8ECE9) outline and 12px corners. Do not use any mint or pastel surface fill, gradient, glow, or decoration. Preserve the ON switch and live voice signal in green (#047857); the native Japanese helper explicitly explains that green indicates detected voice, so this is meaningful status color rather than a panel tint. Keep the switch thumb white and the remaining track neutral. There is no hyperlink in this component, so do not add blue text.

Final canvas is exactly 390×280. Place the card at x16 y8, width358 height256. Place the first row label 入力方法 at x30 y20, 150×24, Meiryo Bold 14px. Place 音声を検出して送信 at x190 y23, 168×16, Meiryo Regular 12px gray. Divider x30 y64 width330 height1. Place 感度を自動で調整 at x30 y88, 270×24, Meiryo Bold 14px. ON switch x310 y87, 48×28, radius14; white thumb x334 y89, 24×24. Place 入力感度 at x30 y144, 330×24, Meiryo Bold 14px. Place neutral rail x30 y188, 328×5, radius2, with green state segment x30 y188, 150×5. Place helper text at x30 y212, 330×32, Meiryo Regular 12px, 16px line-height, two lines exactly: 緑色の表示は、あなたの声を検出して / 送信していることを表します。

The card must end at y264. Keep exact spacing and font scale from the native preview. Do not enlarge the card or Japanese text. Do not add icons, controls, links, labels, shadows, or extra colors. No device frame.
reviewNotes: No mint/pastel surface fills; active switch and voice-detection bar remain green because the native text defines that semantic state. No hyperlink exists, so no blue text. v002 remains about 4px left, 5px high, and 8px too wide at the card; row/divider/slider positions vary by 3-6px. Retain needs-correction after two passes.
